originality.rationale: The source introducing the cross-polytope-sum family establishes Ehrhart/lattice and volume results and already gives a general halfspace description in Proposition 3.5. It therefore covers the elementary reduction to a candidate-distance minimum; the new content is its sharp endpoint solution, n=k^2 threshold, and exact contact facet classification. General signed-permutohedron theory explains candidate normals but not the closed sharp minimization. Closest radius work concerns zonotopes and is not a stronger statement for the k>=3 family. Novelty is evidence-based and provisional.
